about: Fresh variants for the E-1 reply check, written 2026-11-04 BEFORE the structural detector was coded (review #781 QA: score a structural approach on unseen wording). 'block' = the reply prescribes a trading method, a conditional entry or exit, or an action plan for the reader; 'keep' = help, education about UCT features, data, a description of what happened, or general information without a prescribed trading action.
